## Verdict
accepted

## Concerns
- Claim-3 correctly proves admissibility equivalence, provided \(r,q\ge1\), as stated in the strategy.
- Claim-4 is injective only for the augmented data \((r,q,i,j)\); the bare rectangle \(i^j\) is not injective. The draft explicitly preserves this distinction.
- Claim-7 correctly gives 60 and 30 disjoint cases under the stated, noncanonical boundary convention.
- The enumeration proves neither minimality nor verification of the 90 cases; the draft correctly leaves this unresolved.
